name: ngx-vis
description: Angular x components for using vis.js

scripts.flow.compile: npm run flow.compile:common && npm run flow.extract-metadata
scripts.flow.clean: rimraf bundles coverage dist demo-build "components/**/*.+(metadata.json|js|d.ts|js.map)" dist "ngx-vis.+(js|d.ts|js.map)"
scripts.flow.build:demo: (cd dist && npm pack) && (cd demo && npm i ../dist/ngx-vis-*.tgz && npm run build)
scripts.flow.build:github-pages: (cd dist && npm pack) && (cd demo && npm i ../dist/ngx-vis-*.tgz && ng build --base-href=/ngx-vis/ --output-path=../docs)
scripts.build:all: npm run build:lib && npm run build:demo && npm run build:docs
scripts.changelog:add: git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit --no-verify -m 'chore(changelog): Updated CHANGELOG.md'
scripts.release:pre: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.release:post: npm run changelog && npm run changelog:add
scripts.release:major: npm run release:pre && npm version major && npm run release:post && git push origin && git push origin --tags && npm run version-and-push
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:pre && npm version minor && npm run release:post && git push origin && git push origin --tags && npm run version-and-push
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:pre && npm version patch && npm run release:post && git push origin && git push origin --tags && npm run version-and-push
scripts.version-and-push: git push origin && git push origin --tags && npm run publish-and-merge
scripts.publish-and-merge: git checkout main && git merge develop && git push && git checkout develop
